item.title: Thursday, April 23, 2026 — 🛠 CC Code Review · ✨ GPT-Rosalind · 🔵 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
item.description:
Today: 🛠 CC Code Review · ✨ GPT-Rosalind · 🔵 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform · 🛠 CC v2.1.118

• 🛠 **Claude Code multi-agent Code Review** — Anthropic launched Code Review, a new Claude Code feature that dispatches a team of specialized agents to deep-review every PR in parallel. Each agent targets a different class of issue; a verification pass filters false positives before posting a single high-signal summary comment plus in-line findings to GitHub. At Anthropic internally, substantive review comments jumped from 16% to 54% of all PRs — code output per engineer grew 200% this year and reviews had become the bottleneck.
• 🛠 **Claude Code v2.1.118** — Today's release adds vim visual modes and full selection support, merges `/cost` and `/stats` into one view, introduces named custom themes, and lets hooks invoke MCP tools directly without a bash wrapper. Also added: `DISABLE_UPDATES` environment variable for locked-down CI environments, WSL settings inheritance from the host, and MCP OAuth token-refresh fixes.
• 🟢 **OpenAI launches GPT-Rosalind for drug discovery and life sciences** — OpenAI's first domain-specific frontier model, named after Rosalind Franklin and purpose-built for biology, protein engineering, genomics, and drug discovery. It connects to 50+ scientific databases and tools via a new Life Sciences research plugin. Partners in the trusted access program include Amgen, Moderna, the Allen Institute, and Thermo Fisher. Aim: compress the 10–15 year timeline from target discovery to drug approval.
• 🔵 **Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform: Projects, Canvas, and Inbox** — Also from Google Cloud Next 2026 (not covered yesterday): Gemini Enterprise is being rebuilt as a multi-agent workspace. **Projects** gives teams a shared context space where humans and agents co-create, pulling from Workspace and OneDrive. **Canvas** adds collaborative AI editing directly in Docs and Slides. **Inbox** is a centralized dashboard for managing long-running agents grouped by status (needs input / errors / completed). A no-code/low-code **Agent Designer** lets workers build custom agents without leaving the platform.
• 🎥 **Parallel Claude Code + Git Worktrees: This Setup Will Change How You Ship** — **Cole Medin** (24 min) — Full walkthrough of running multiple Claude Code instances in parallel using git worktrees — one per feature branch, no context bleed between tasks. A practical productivity setup that pairs well with today's multi-agent Code Review announcement.
• 🎥 **Claude just got another superpower...** — **Fireship** (5 min) — Fast-format take on Claude Design, Anthropic Labs' new tool for generating polished designs, prototypes, slides, and one-pagers collaboratively with Claude. Fireship frames it as potentially Anthropic's most disruptive product move for non-developers, since it competes directly with Canva and Figma workflows.
• 💬 r/LocalLLaMA: "Qwen3 TTS is seriously underrated — I got it running locally in real-time and it's one of the most expressive open TTS models I've tried" — Real-time local inference on Qwen's text-to-speech model, with community members sharing audio samples; early consensus is it outperforms ElevenLabs on expressiveness for zero-shot voice cloning.
• 💬 r/LocalLLM: "I built a real-life MAGI System from Evangelion using an Nvidia A16 and four isolated LLMs." — Engineering post on running four LLM instances in parallel consensus mode on a single A16, inspired by Evangelion's MAGI supercomputer. Includes the full repo and notes on inter-agent voting logic.

item.title: Wednesday, April 22, 2026 — 🛠 CC v2.1.117 · 🟡 Qwen3.6-27B · 🔵 Google TPU 8t/8i
item.description:
Today: 🛠 CC v2.1.117 · 🟡 Qwen3.6-27B · 🔵 Google TPU 8t/8i · 🔵 Gemini in Chrome · 🔒 Mythos breach · 🔧 SpaceX-Cursor $60B

• 🔥 **Anthropic's Mythos Preview accessed by unauthorized users** — Anthropic's highly restricted cybersecurity AI — capable of finding zero-day vulnerabilities at scale — was accessed by an unauthorized Discord group the same day it was publicly announced. Access came through compromised credentials at a third-party contractor vendor; Anthropic had limited Mythos Preview to a handful of partners (Amazon, Apple, JP Morgan) under Project Glasswing. The company is investigating but says no Anthropic systems were directly impacted.
• 🛠 **Claude Code briefly removed from Pro plan, then restored** — Anthropic's pricing page was quietly updated today to remove Claude Code from the $20/mo Pro tier, showing it as Max-only ($100+). Within hours it was reversed after community backlash on Reddit and X. Anthropic's head of growth said it was a ~2% test on new signups only and that existing Pro and Max subscribers were never affected.
• 🛠 **Claude Code v2.1.117** — Today's release: MCP servers now start concurrently for faster tool loading, agent frontmatter `mcpServers` works in main-thread sessions, `/model` selections persist across restarts, `/resume` offers session summarization for very large conversations, and the default effort level is raised to `high` for Pro and Max subscribers.
• 🔵 **Google Cloud Next 2026: TPU 8t and TPU 8i chips unveiled** — Google unveiled its eighth-generation custom AI silicon in two purpose-built variants: TPU 8t (training, scales to 9,600 chips in a single superpod, 3x faster and 80% better performance-per-dollar than Ironwood) and TPU 8i (inference, 3x more on-chip SRAM for concurrently running millions of agents at low latency). Also announced at Cloud Next: Jules coding agent exits beta and is now free across all tiers; Gemini 3 Flash becomes the Gemini app default.
• 🔧 **SpaceX secures option to acquire Cursor for $60 billion** — SpaceX and AI coding startup Cursor signed a deal: $10B for collaboration on coding and knowledge-work AI using SpaceX's Colossus supercomputer, with an option for SpaceX to acquire Cursor outright for $60B later this year. Cursor currently relies on Claude and GPT models while competing against their makers; this would let SpaceX vertically integrate a dominant coding platform ahead of its anticipated IPO.
• 🟡 **Qwen3.6-27B: flagship-level coding in a 27B dense model** — Alibaba's Qwen team released a 27B dense model that outperforms the previous open-source flagship (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, 807GB) on all major coding benchmarks, now at 16.8GB GGUF for local use. Simon Willison tested it at 24-25 tok/s locally — strong coding performance without specialized hardware.
• 🎥 **Mythos leaks, SpaceX buys Cursor and OpenAI drops GPT Image 2.0** — **Wes Roth** (19m 20s) — News roundup covering the three biggest stories of the day: Anthropic's Mythos unauthorized-access incident, SpaceX's $60B Cursor acquisition option, and continued GPT Image 2 community reactions.
• 🎥 **Claude Context: This NEW & SIMPLE PLUGIN is CRAZY!** — **AICodeKing** (10m 53s) — Walkthrough of a new Claude Code plugin for context management. Useful if you're hitting context limits in large coding sessions or want tighter control over what Claude sees per task.

item.title: Tuesday, April 21, 2026
item.description:
• 🔥 **Amazon Invests Up to $25 Billion in Anthropic as Part of $100B AWS Deal** — Amazon is committing $5B now plus up to $20B more contingent on commercial milestones, bringing its total stake to ~$33B at Anthropic's current $380B valuation. In return, Anthropic pledges over $100B in AWS spend — including up to 5 gigawatts of Trainium capacity — over the next decade. The deal mirrors Amazon's $50B OpenAI investment announced in February.
• 🛠 **Claude Code v2.1.116** — `/resume` is up to 67% faster on large sessions (40 MB+) and MCP startup is faster when multiple stdio servers are configured. The thinking spinner now shows inline progress messages ("still thinking", "thinking more", "almost done thinking"). Usage tab now reliably displays both 5-hour and weekly consumption data.
• 💜 **Claude for Word Launches for Pro and Max** — Claude (backed by Opus 4.7) is now available inside Microsoft Word for Pro and Max subscribers, enabling in-document drafting, revision, citation insertion, and long-form summarization without leaving the editor. Announced April 17; aimed at legal, consulting, and marketing workflows that live in Microsoft 365.
• 🛠 **Claude Cowork Now Builds Live Artifacts** — Anthropic's web-based collaborative workspace can now generate interactive live artifacts — functioning mini-apps, charts, and components rendered inline — not just static code snippets. Bridges the gap between Cowork's research/planning layer and Claude Code's implementation layer.
• 🟢 **OpenAI GPT Image 2 Rolling Out to ChatGPT** — OpenAI's next-generation image model is now live for ChatGPT users, with community reports of dramatically improved complex scene generation ("10× the complexity, near-perfect") and near-perfect text rendering inside images. Represents a major leap over the DALL-E era in compositing and multi-object accuracy. DALL-E is scheduled to retire by May 12.
• 🟢 **GPT-5.4-Cyber: OpenAI's Defensive Cybersecurity Model** — A specialized GPT-5.4 variant optimized for defensive security: vulnerability discovery, code auditing, and threat analysis. OpenAI is expanding its Trusted Access for Cyber (TAC) program to reach thousands of individual security professionals. The controlled rollout aims to give defenders early advantages over attackers in the same model generation.
• 🟡 **Kimi K2.6 Released on HuggingFace — Available Now** — Moonshot AI's K2.6 moved from beta to an actual open-weight release you can pull and run locally today. Community benchmarks show it trading blows with Claude Opus 4.7 on coding tasks at zero API cost; the underlying MoE architecture runs at 24 tok/s on a pair of Mac Studios.
• 📰 **AI Cognitive Offloading — The "Boiling Frog" Effect** — A joint UCLA/MIT/Oxford/Carnegie Mellon study gave 1,222 participants AI assistants for 10 minutes then removed them; performance dropped *below* the control group and participants stopped trying. The researchers named this the "boiling frog" effect: brief AI assistance may degrade independent problem-solving capacity faster than participants notice.

item.title: Monday, April 20, 2026
item.description:
• 🔥 **Claude Opus 4.7 Now Available** — Anthropic's flagship model jumps to Opus 4.7 with significantly better complex coding, sustained multi-step reasoning, and 3× sharper vision (up to 2,576px — over 3.75 megapixels). Pricing is unchanged from 4.6: $5/1M input, $25/1M output.
• 🛠 **Introducing Claude Design by Anthropic Labs** — New research-preview product that lets you collaborate with Claude (Opus 4.7) to create designs, prototypes, slides, and one-pagers from text prompts, screenshots, or codebases. Direct handoff to Claude Code bridges design and development in one loop.
• 🛠 **Claude Code v2.1.113** — Substantial quality-of-life release: the CLI now spawns a native binary instead of bundled JavaScript (faster cold starts), and a new `sandbox.network.deniedDomains` setting lets you block specific domains even when broader network access is enabled.
• 🛠 **Claude Code Hackathon Returns for Opus 4.7** — Anthropic is running a new hackathon with a $100,000 prize pool in API credits, focused on what Opus 4.7 unlocks for agentic coding. Good moment to apply if you've been building something with Claude Code.
• 🟢 **GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark Research Preview** — OpenAI's first model explicitly optimized for real-time coding: delivers over 1,000 tokens/second while maintaining code quality, making it feel near-instant for interactive use. Available now to ChatGPT Pro users via the Codex app, CLI, and IDE extension.
• 🟢 **OpenAI Introduces GPT-Rosalind** — A frontier reasoning model purpose-built for biology, drug discovery, and translational medicine; optimized scientific workflows with improved tool use and deep understanding of chemistry, protein engineering, and genomics. Signals OpenAI is building domain-specialized reasoning models alongside general ones.
• 🔵 **Google Jules Out of Beta** — Google's asynchronous coding agent is now available across free and paid tiers (including Google AI Pro/Ultra). Jules integrates directly with repos, works in the background without blocking you, then surfaces a plan, reasoning trace, and diff when it finishes.
• 🔵 **Gemini 3 Flash Is the New Default in the Gemini App** — Google upgraded its consumer app's default model to Gemini 3 Flash, describing it as a "major capability upgrade over 2.5 Flash." Gemini in Chrome side panel is also rolling out to Windows and Mac for AI Pro/Ultra subscribers.
